verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe a "Deploy Private Models" offering: you can run your own fine-tuned weights on a dedicated A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 instance with autoscaling and a private endpoint. Rentable GPU clusters with SSH access are offered as a full-control fallback. Missing for 10: any mention of LoRA adapter support, documentation of the weight upload workflow and supported formats, pricing for dedicated custom-model hosting versus per-token, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
